other.equipment: Edmund-Buhler AM/0.5 high vacuum arc-melting system

evidence.quote: The cylindrical rods with a diameter of 8 mm and a length of 150 mm were prepared using a copper mold tilting-cast method in Edmund-Buhler AM/0.5 high vacuum arc-melting system.
The as-cast rods were used for the directional solidification conducted in an FZ-T-12000-X-VP-S type optical floating zone furnace at different growth rates.

attributes.composition: Ti, Ni, Hf and Fe enriched (Nb-poor)

evidence.quote: EDS technology further confirmed that Nb is enriched in the white phase while Ti, Ni, Hf and Fe are segregated in the black one... the white phase is BCC phase and the black one is B2 phase.
The width of the BCC phase lamellar is determined to be approximately 20 nm due to rapid solidification.
the TC EHEA specimens display a few white dendrites and typical lamellar eutectic microstructure
All the specimens contain B2 and BCC phases with no other phases detected in Fig. 1a.
the width or diameter of BCC phase is about 200 nm in DS specimens, far larger than that of BCC phase in TC specimens

attributes.morphology: columnar grains aligned along DS direction; fiber eutectic in center, lamellar eutectic outside

evidence.quote: The details in one cluster with a size of ~ 240 µm can be seen in Fig. 1e at high magnification, where the center contains Nb fibers and the outside is in the lamellar eutectic microstructure
It is seen that the columnar grains were aligned along the DS direction.
in the 60 mm/h specimens, the IPF map reveals that both Nb-poor B2 phase and Nb-rich BCC phase both form preferred orientation and {100} <011> textures.
All the specimens contain B2 and BCC phases with no other phases detected in Fig. 1a.

the 60 mm/h DS alloy exhibits the largest superelasticity and the highest strength in the tensile test, because only in the 60 mm/h DS alloy do the crystals take the [011] as the orientation whatever in BCC or B2 phases

mechanisms.name: synergetic effect of soft BCC and high-strength B2 phases

evidence.quote: the soft BCC phase will prevent the B2 phase catastrophically fracturing because it is beneficial to release the stress concentration through its plastic deformation. Meanwhile, the strength of BCC phase will enhance due to the confinement of B2 phase.

mechanisms.name: high-entropy core effect on martensitic transformation

evidence.quote: the introduction of multicomponent makes NiTi-like B2 phase with the elevated activation energy for deformation-induced martensitic transformation due to HEA’s core effects, which contributes to high strength as well as superelasticity and SME
size effect and confinement effect in eutectic structure are presented in Nb-rich lamella or fibers, which make it difficult to plastic deformation so as to show its own ultra-elasticity

mechanisms.name: plastic deformation of coarse Nb-rich BCC particles

evidence.quote: It is inferred that the plastic deformation of big Nb-rich BCC phase particles contributes to the yield of these specimens. That is why the 1 mm/h and 180 mm/h DS samples exhibit the yield phenomena at the quite low stress.
